note: One night's actual events plus shot-quality context — single-game numbers are NOISE and nothing here is WAR. The night index (the game grade) = 0.75·G + 0.60·A + 0.60·ixG + 0.075·SOG + 0.05·HIT + 0.15·BLK + 0.15·TK − 0.15·GV + 0.50·(even-strength on-ice xG tilt, xGF−xGA while he's out there) — so a +1.5-tilted night counts like a goal, and a shutdown night can grade without a point. A transparent, descriptive composite; the tilt is unadjusted for teammates/competition (season RAPM does that). Goalie GSAx = xG of non-empty-net shots faced minus goals against, the same spine as the season number, at single-game grain.
